desc: Lantern spirit: a pale paper-lantern body with a void face and three gold star-shaped flame tails. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Round black void face with two small white dot eyes. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
